#### A. Buffer Overflow Risk in HTMLparser.c
**File**: HTMLparser.c  
**Function**: `htmlnamePush` (lines ~110-135)  
**Issue**: Dynamic array reallocation without proper bounds checking

```c
static int
htmlnamePush(htmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, const xmlChar * value)
{
    if (ctxt->nameNr >= ctxt->nameMax) {
        size_t newSize = ctxt->nameMax * 2;  // Potential integer overflow
        const xmlChar **tmp;

        tmp = xmlRealloc((xmlChar **) ctxt->nameTab,
                         newSize * sizeof(ctxt->nameTab[0]));
        if (tmp == NULL) {
            htmlErrMemory(ctxt);
            return (-1);
        }
        ctxt->nameTab = tmp;
        ctxt->nameMax = newSize;
    }
    ctxt->nameTab[ctxt->nameNr] = value;
    ctxt->name = value;
    return (ctxt->nameNr++);
}
```

**Vulnerability**: Integer overflow when `ctxt->nameMax * 2` could wrap around on systems where `size_t` multiplication overflows.

#### B. Similar Issue in htmlNodeInfoPush
